chapter: With Chick Webb and Ella Fitzgerald, 1936-39
title: Beverly Peer and the Webb band's recorded history
summary: They cover bassist Beverly Peer and the sidemen on Webb recordings from 1933 on, including Charles Linton's vocals.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel
